script_text: Sagittarius, this week Jupiter ignites a cosmic explosion in your life you did not see coming. Early week, Mercury sizzles through your 9th house, forming a powerful trine to your ruling planet Jupiter as well as the North Node in your 11th house sparking bold conversations, travel ideas, and invitations you simply cannot refuse. Tuesday is your best day because Mercury sizzles through your 9th house, forming a powerful trine to your ruling planet Jupiter. By Wednesday, a tense square from Mars in your 3rd house warns you to watch your words, avoid signing documents impulsively. This is your worst day. Thursday brings the shift: Venus slips into your 5th house of romance, igniting passion and creative fire all weekend. Expect a magnetic connection to surface Friday evening. Career-wise, the Sun in your 10th house sextile Saturn means a professional opportunity arrives Saturday, so keep your eyes open. Your lucky color is emerald green, and your power numbers are 7, 11, and 21. One tip: say yes to unexpected invitations this week, the universe is rearranging your path. Follow for daily updates.
